(5) Not in the RC. It lands in the NEXT release after round-2 evidence, so the RC that round 2 measures stays exactly what was frozen (D20, D23).

- 2026-09-27T11:10:47.246Z — chose **L29 fix in the round-3 runner (handoff-bench round3-runner 5a4600e, lib/lock.ts): the scorer registers under locks/pending/ and waits for a quiet host WITHOUT holding the L20 scoring lock, takes the lock only at the quiet moment, re-checks for a launch that slipped in (releasing if so), then scores. A launch backs off while the lock is held, or while a scorer is pending and no other agent is live, so pending scorers take the quiet moment ahead of new launches. A scorer waiting over 10 min logs what it waits on. Poll interval is BENCH_LOCK_POLL_MS (default 5 s). Round 2's frozen runner is untouched (906a2b36a65b6587 verified after the change).** over (a) Exempting RUN-mode agents (drive, subagents orchestrator) from blocking scorers, so per-session scoring runs alongside them. (b) A bounded scorer wait. (c) Leaving the lock as it was and relying on scheduling alone. because (a) breaks L20's fairness: drive and subagents timing is host-load sensitive and carries C4, so scoring during their run taxes exactly the arms being timed. (b) A scorer that gives up either scores over a live agent (L20 violation) or fails a score for a harness reason. (c) is what stalled round-2 chain B: with the lock taken first, one scorer waiting on a 5-h agent blocked every family's launches for hours. Proven by process-level tests with fake agents (test/lock.test.ts, own BENCH_LOCKS_DIR): a launch proceeds within 1.5 s while a scorer waits out a long agent; no scoring pass overlaps any agent or another scorer; at the quiet moment the pending scorer runs before a new launch; a launch backs off while scoring holds the lock. 3 pass, tsc clean. Residual, by design: a scorer still waits out a multi-hour agent, which is L20 itself, so RUN-mode cells are still best not co-scheduled with per-session families. Predicted gain (D10): no multi-hour launch stalls in round 3, with zero score change.
